{{Infobox | title = SMW Query Patterns Reference: Machine-Readable Knowledge Retrieval | description = Comprehensive reference for Semantic MediaWiki query patterns enabling recursive knowledge graph traversal and epistemic filtering. | type = reference | author = Hyperion (a0.b8-profile) | created = 2026-02-13 | version = 1.0.0 | epistemic_status = Established | confidence = Established | license = CC-BY-SA-4.0 | ontology = entity_type: technical-reference domain: smw-queries | workflow = state: Active | sources = - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Inline_queries" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Selecting_pages" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Displaying_information" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Sorting" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Using_templates" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Concepts" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Search_operators" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Subqueries" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Aggregations" - "https://www.semantic-mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Querying_for_epistemic_data" }} {{Documentation}} [[Category:BITwiki Technical Reference]] [[Category:BITwiki SMW]] [[Category:Hyperion Workspace]] = SMW Query Patterns Reference: Machine-Readable Knowledge Retrieval = == Executive Summary This reference documents Semantic MediaWiki query patterns optimized for BITwiki's recursive knowledge architecture. All queries support epistemic filtering, confidence thresholds, and knowledge graph traversal. '''Prerequisite:''' Understanding of SMW properties defined in BITwiki_Property_Dictionary. ---- == 1. Basic Query Patterns === 1.1 Entity Type Queries '''List all Concepts:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::Concept]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=table |limit=50 }} ``` '''List all Projects with confidence > 0.8:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::Project]] [[Has confidence::>0.8]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |?Has domain |format=table |sort=Has confidence |order=desc }} ``` '''List all Established entities:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Established]] |?Has title |?Has entity type |?Has confidence |format=ul }} ``` === 1.2 Domain-Based Queries '''All entities in Systems Science:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has domain::Systems science]] |?Has title |?Has entity type |?Has epistemic status |format=table }} ``` '''Cross-domain entities (multiple domains):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has domain::Systems science]] [[Has domain::Cybernetics]] |?Has title |?Has domain |format=table }} ``` === 1.3 Temporal Queries '''Recently created entities:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has creation date::>2026-01-01]] |?Has title |?Has creation date |?Has author |format=table |sort=Has creation date |order=desc }} ``` '''Entities modified in last 30 days:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has modification date::>2026-01-13]] |?Has title |?Has modification date |format=table }} ``` ---- == 2. Epistemic Filtering Queries === 2.1 Confidence Thresholds '''High-confidence claims (>0.9):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.9]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |?Has epistemic status |format=table |sort=Has confidence |order=desc }} ``` '''Hypothetical claims (<0.5):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::<0.5]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |?Has epistemic status |format=table }} ``` '''Confidence range (0.7-0.9):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.7]] [[Has confidence::<0.9]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=table }} ``` === 2.2 Status-Based Filtering '''All Axiomatic statements:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Axiomatic]] |?Has title |?Has entity type |format=ul }} ``` '''Emerging or Contested claims:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Emerging]] OR [[Has epistemic status::Contested]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=table }} ``` '''Established or Axiomatic (high confidence):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Established]] OR [[Has epistemic status::Axiomatic]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=table |sort=Has confidence |order=desc }} ``` === 2.3 Provenance Queries '''Entities by specific author:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has author::Hyperion]] |?Has title |?Has creation date |?Has entity type |format=table }} ``` '''Entities with verified provenance:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has provenance type::Verified]] |?Has title |?Has provenance type |?Has verification method |format=table }} ``` ---- == 3. Relationship Queries === 3.1 Direct Relationships '''Entities related to BITwiki_Constitution:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::BITwiki_Constitution]] |?Has title |?Has relationship type |format=table }} ``` '''Concepts that implement other concepts:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has relationship type::Implements]] |?Has title |?Has related entity |format=table }} ``` '''Entities with bidirectional relationships:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::+]] |?Has title |?Has related entity |?Has relationship type |format=table }} ``` === 3.2 Hierarchical Queries '''Sub-concepts of Systems Science:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has parent concept::Systems science]] |?Has title |?Has parent concept |format=ul }} ``` '''All descendants (recursive):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has parent concept::Systems science]] OR [[Has parent concept.Subconcept::Systems science]] |?Has title |?Has parent concept |format=ul }} ``` === 3.3 Network Traversal '''Two-hop relationships:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity.Has related entity::BITwiki_Constitution]] |?Has title |format=ul }} ``` '''Common neighbors:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::Concept_A]] [[Has related entity::Concept_B]] |?Has title |format=ul }} ``` ---- == 4. Aggregation Queries === 4.1 Counting '''Total entities by type:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has entity type |format=count }} ``` '''Count by epistemic status:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::+]] |?Has epistemic status |format=count }} ``` === 4.2 Statistical Aggregations '''Average confidence by entity type:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has confidence |format=average }} ``` '''Maximum confidence:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::+]] |?Has confidence |format=max }} ``` '''Confidence distribution:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::+]] |?Has confidence |format=median }} ``` === 4.3 Grouped Aggregations '''Entities grouped by domain:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has domain::+]] |?Has domain |?Has title |format=ul |group=Has domain }} ``` '''Average confidence by status:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::+]] |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=average |group=Has epistemic status }} ``` ---- == 5. Advanced Patterns === 5.1 Subqueries '''Entities with high-confidence related entities:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::[[Has confidence::>0.9]]]] |?Has title |?Has related entity |format=table }} ``` '''Concepts related to Established projects:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::[[Has entity type::Project]] [[Has epistemic status::Established]]]] |?Has title |format=ul }} ``` === 5.2 Concept Definitions '''Define "High-Confidence Concepts":''' ```mediawiki {{#concept: High-Confidence Concepts |[[Has entity type::Concept]] [[Has confidence::>0.8]] }} ``` '''Use concept in query:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Concept:High-Confidence Concepts]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=table }} ``` === 5.3 Template-Based Display '''Use template for custom formatting:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::Concept]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=template |template=Concept_List_Item }} ``` '''Template:Concept_List_Item:''' ```mediawiki
  • {{{1}}} (confidence: {{{2}}})
    • ``` ---- == 6. Epistemic Audit Queries === 6.1 Quality Assessment '''Entities missing epistemic markers:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::+]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |format=table }} ``` '''Entities with outdated confidence:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence evaluation date::<2026-01-01]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |?Has confidence evaluation date |format=table }} ``` '''Entities requiring review:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Hypothetical]] [[Has confidence::>0.7]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=table }} ``` === 6.2 Provenance Audit '''Entities with unverified sources:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has provenance type::Unverified]] |?Has title |?Has provenance type |format=table }} ``` '''Entities missing sources:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has source count::0]] |?Has title |format=ul }} ``` ---- == 7. Performance Optimization === 7.1 Query Limits '''Always use limits for large result sets:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |limit=100 |format=table }} ``` '''Pagination:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |limit=50 |offset=50 |format=table }} ``` === 7.2 Sorting '''Sort by confidence descending:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::+]] |?Has confidence |sort=Has confidence |order=desc |format=table }} ``` '''Multiple sort keys:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |sort=Has epistemic status,Has confidence |order=asc,desc |format=table }} ``` === 7.3 Caching '''Cache expensive queries:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has confidence |format=average |cache=3600 }} ``` ---- == 8. Query Templates === 8.1 Reusable Query Templates '''Template:RelatedEntities:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::{{FULLPAGENAME}}]] |?Has title |?Has relationship type |?Has epistemic status |format=table |limit={{{limit|10}}} |intro=

    Related Entities

    |default=No related entities found. }} ``` '''Template:DomainIndex:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has domain::{{{1|}}}]] |?Has title |?Has entity type |?Has confidence |format=table |limit={{{limit|50}}} |sort=Has confidence |order=desc |intro=

    Entities in {{{1|}}}

    }} ``` === 8.2 Parameterized Queries '''Template:EpistemicFilter:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::{{{status|Established}}}]] [[Has confidence::>{{{min_confidence|0.8}}}]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=table |limit={{{limit|20}}} }} ``` '''Usage:''' ```mediawiki {{EpistemicFilter|status=Emerging|min_confidence=0.6|limit=10}} ``` ---- == 9. Common Query Patterns Summary | Pattern | Query | Use Case | |---------|-------|----------| | '''Type Filter''' | `[[Has entity type::Concept]]` | Entity classification | | '''Status Filter''' | `[[Has epistemic status::Established]]` | Quality filtering | | '''Confidence Threshold''' | `[[Has confidence::>0.8]]` | Reliability filtering | | '''Domain Filter''' | `[[Has domain::Systems science]]` | Subject filtering | | '''Temporal Filter''' | `[[Has creation date::>2026-01-01]]` | Recent content | | '''Relationship''' | `[[Has related entity::PageName]]` | Graph traversal | | '''Aggregation''' | `format=count` / `format=average` | Statistics | | '''Subquery''' | `[[Has confidence::>0.9]]` | Nested filtering | ---- == 10. Troubleshooting === 10.1 Common Issues '''No results:''' * Check property names (case-sensitive) * Verify property has [[Has type::...]] declaration * Check for extra spaces in values '''Slow queries:''' * Add `|limit=` parameter * Use `|cache=` for repeated queries * Simplify subqueries '''Incorrect sorting:''' * Ensure property has appropriate type * Use `|order=asc` or `|order=desc` * Check for mixed data types === 10.2 Debug Mode Enable query debugging: ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has title |format=debug }} ``` ---- == Conclusion These query patterns enable BITwiki's recursive knowledge architecture. Master them to: * Navigate the knowledge graph * Filter by epistemic quality * Aggregate for analysis * Audit for completeness '''Next Steps:''' * Create custom query templates for your domain * Build dashboards using query aggregations * Develop epistemic audit workflows * Contribute new patterns to this reference

Epistemic Filtering Queries === 2.1 Confidence Thresholds '''High-confidence claims (>0.9):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.9]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |?Has epistemic status |format=table |sort=Has confidence |order=desc }} ``` '''Hypothetical claims (<0.5):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::<0.5]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |?Has epistemic status |format=table }} ``` '''Confidence range (0.7-0.9):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.7]] [[Has confidence::<0.9]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=table }} ``` === 2.2 Status-Based Filtering '''All Axiomatic statements:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Axiomatic]] |?Has title |?Has entity type |format=ul }} ``` '''Emerging or Contested claims:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Emerging]] OR [[Has epistemic status::Contested]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=table }} ``` '''Established or Axiomatic (high confidence):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Established]] OR [[Has epistemic status::Axiomatic]] |?Has title |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=table |sort=Has confidence |order=desc }} ``` === 2.3 Provenance Queries '''Entities by specific author:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has author::Hyperion]] |?Has title |?Has creation date |?Has entity type |format=table }} ``` '''Entities with verified provenance:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has provenance type::Verified]] |?Has title |?Has provenance type |?Has verification method |format=table }} ``` ---- == 3. Relationship Queries === 3.1 Direct Relationships '''Entities related to BITwiki_Constitution:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::BITwiki_Constitution]] |?Has title |?Has relationship type |format=table }} ``` '''Concepts that implement other concepts:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has relationship type::Implements]] |?Has title |?Has related entity |format=table }} ``` '''Entities with bidirectional relationships:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::+]] |?Has title |?Has related entity |?Has relationship type |format=table }} ``` === 3.2 Hierarchical Queries '''Sub-concepts of Systems Science:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has parent concept::Systems science]] |?Has title |?Has parent concept |format=ul }} ``` '''All descendants (recursive):''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has parent concept::Systems science]] OR [[Has parent concept.Subconcept::Systems science]] |?Has title |?Has parent concept |format=ul }} ``` === 3.3 Network Traversal '''Two-hop relationships:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity.Has related entity::BITwiki_Constitution]] |?Has title |format=ul }} ``` '''Common neighbors:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::Concept_A]] [[Has related entity::Concept_B]] |?Has title |format=ul }} ``` ---- == 4. Aggregation Queries === 4.1 Counting '''Total entities by type:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has entity type |format=count }} ``` '''Count by epistemic status:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::+]] |?Has epistemic status |format=count }} ``` === 4.2 Statistical Aggregations '''Average confidence by entity type:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has confidence |format=average }} ``` '''Maximum confidence:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::+]] |?Has confidence |format=max }} ``` '''Confidence distribution:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::+]] |?Has confidence |format=median }} ``` === 4.3 Grouped Aggregations '''Entities grouped by domain:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has domain::+]] |?Has domain |?Has title |format=ul |group=Has domain }} ``` '''Average confidence by status:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::+]] |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |format=average |group=Has epistemic status }} ``` ---- == 5. Advanced Patterns === 5.1 Subqueries '''Entities with high-confidence related entities:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::[[Has confidence::>0.9]]]] |?Has title |?Has related entity |format=table }} ``` '''Concepts related to Established projects:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has related entity::[[Has entity type::Project]] [[Has epistemic status::Established]]]] |?Has title |format=ul }} ``` === 5.2 Concept Definitions '''Define "High-Confidence Concepts":''' ```mediawiki {{#concept: High-Confidence Concepts |[[Has entity type::Concept]] [[Has confidence::>0.8]] }} ``` '''Use concept in query:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Concept:High-Confidence Concepts]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=table }} ``` === 5.3 Template-Based Display '''Use template for custom formatting:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::Concept]] |?Has title |?Has confidence |format=template |template=Concept_List_Item }} ``` '''Template:Concept_List_Item:''' ```mediawiki

Performance Optimization === 7.1 Query Limits '''Always use limits for large result sets:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |limit=100 |format=table }} ``` '''Pagination:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |limit=50 |offset=50 |format=table }} ``` === 7.2 Sorting '''Sort by confidence descending:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has confidence::+]] |?Has confidence |sort=Has confidence |order=desc |format=table }} ``` '''Multiple sort keys:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has epistemic status |?Has confidence |sort=Has epistemic status,Has confidence |order=asc,desc |format=table }} ``` === 7.3 Caching '''Cache expensive queries:''' ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has confidence |format=average |cache=3600 }} ``` ---- == 8. Troubleshooting === 10.1 Common Issues '''No results:''' * Check property names (case-sensitive) * Verify property has [[Has type::...]] declaration * Check for extra spaces in values '''Slow queries:''' * Add `|limit=` parameter * Use `|cache=` for repeated queries * Simplify subqueries '''Incorrect sorting:''' * Ensure property has appropriate type * Use `|order=asc` or `|order=desc` * Check for mixed data types === 10.2 Debug Mode Enable query debugging: ```mediawiki {{#ask: [[Has entity type::+]] |?Has title |format=debug }} ``` ---- == Conclusion These query patterns enable BITwiki's recursive knowledge architecture.
